messages:
Raju S: Hey everyone — I’m Raju, just joined Eng Infra from Mumbai! Remote IST timezone, will be overlapping mornings with you folks. Big fan of chai and panipuri. Excited to be here :wave:
Olivia K: Welcome Raju! :tada: Nice to have someone from Mumbai. Which neighborhood?
Raju S: Bandra — small apartment, lots of plants. Also a huge dosa fan. 
Mira P: Bandra! Nice. FYI we do a casual AM sync for APAC-friendly folks sometimes. No pressure at all.
Sam R: welcome! quick and completely unscientific poll: reply with :tea: or :coffee: — which team fuel?
Dana L: :tea: (chai, obviously)
Olivia K: :tea: from me too. But will debate for cold brew.
Alex (hiring-bot): Welcome Raju! Onboarding checklist: Okta created, Slack invite sent, #eng access granted, calendar invites: "New Hire Welcome" + "Team Intro" posted.
Raju S: Got the invites, thanks Alex. Also — is there a sticker pack or swag form to request a laptop sticker? :)
Mira P: yes! swag form is linked in #people-ops pinned messages. I’ll send you the google form.
Sam R: Heads up: we normally do a virtual lunch meet for new hires — will schedule something next week at 08:30 IST so folks in India can join.
Raju S: I’d love that. Can someone share favorite street-food recs? Need recommendations when I’m jetlagged and craving carbs.
Dana L: vada pav and bhel puri are the underrated winners. Also DM me if you want dotfiles — I remap Caps Lock for easier Vim.
Raju S: Please! I’m still getting muscle memory for shortcuts.
Olivia K: Adding a quick Hangout for 08:30 IST tomorrow for a casual hello; drop in if you can. Also tagging @mira for the plant-swap note — we have a low-light pothos to give away if anyone wants it. :seedling:
Mira P: Yup, that pothos is available — happy to ship or give during next in-person.
Sam R: Welcome again, Raju! :thumbsup: Very happy to have you.
Raju S: Thanks all — thrilled to be here. Looking forward to meeting people and stealing some sticker ideas. :grin:
